create_bleu_scorer: create a Bleu instance to compute BLEU scores up to n-grams for image caption evaluation
compute_bleu_score: compute BLEU score by passing ground truth and result dictionaries keyed by image IDs
test_bleu_compute_score: test the Bleu compute_score method with matching ground truth and result dictionaries
refactor_bleu_compute_score: refactor the Bleu compute_score method to support alternative scoring options like shortest or average
review_bleu_method: review the Bleu class method that returns the scorer name string
